# YouTube & Internet Culture Resources

> > A curated collection of resources about YouTube, viral internet memes, and digital culture trends, featuring platform documentation, meme encyclopedias, and scientific content.

This resource hub combines official YouTube platform resources with Know Your Meme's comprehensive documentation of viral trends, TikTok phenomena, and internet culture. It serves as a reference for understanding video-sharing platforms, social media trends, and contemporary digital communication.

## Key Topics

- YouTube
- TikTok
- Know Your Meme
- Viral memes and trends
- Video sharing platforms
- Internet culture and slang
- Social media phenomena
- YouTube Premium and services
- Google/Alphabet Inc.
- Content creators
- Viral video explanations
- Catchphrases and exploitables
- Platform founders (Chad Hurley, Jawed Karim, Steve Chen)
- Digital community trends

## YouTube Platform & Apps

- [YouTube](https://youtube.com): YouTube homepage - video sharing platform owned by Google
- [YouTube App - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/youtube/id544007664): YouTube mobile app listing on Apple's App Store for iOS devices
- [Official YouTube Blog for Latest YouTube News & Insights](https://blog.youtube): YouTube's official blog featuring creator stories and platform news
- [YouTube - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube): Wikipedia entry on YouTube's history, founders, and platform features

- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl? The Viral Memes About Somali-American ICE Victim Nasra Ahmed Explained](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Explanation of viral memes about Nasra Ahmed's ICE detention speech
- [What Do The Memes About Hearing Saxophones In The Hood Mean? The Viral '90s Hood Movie Trend Explained](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/what-do-the-memes-about-hearing-saxophones-in-the-hood-mean-the-viral-90s-hood-movie-trend-explained): Guide explaining Boyz n the Hood saxophone meme trend on TikTok

## Meme Reference Database

- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White and Jesse Pinkman
- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Know Your Meme entry on heartbreaking viral exploitable image meme
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB and YKNiece's rap song 'Innit'
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok
- [Millennial Burger Place | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/millennial-burger-place): Meme about cliche millennial burger restaurant stereotypes on TikTok
